title: Crunchy Seed Sprinkle
description: Toasted pumpkin, linseed, sunflower and chia seeds coated in soy sauce (savoury) or maple syrup (sweet) for a crunchy topping.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce (savoury) OR 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup (sweet)
steps: In a medium-sized frying pan, toast the seeds over a high heat for 2 minutes, shuffling them around to prevent burning.
Take the pan off the heat and immediately add the soy sauce or maple syrup, quickly stirring it through all the seeds. Keep mixing while the liquid evaporates and the seeds pick up the flavour.
Leave to cool completely, then stir again to break down any clumps that have formed. Transfer into an airtight container to store for up to 1 month.
notes: Savoury version is perfect over rice and grains, curries, salads, grilled vegetables or meat. Sweet maple version is lovely on porridge, scattered over yogurt and fruit, or on rice pudding. Beware of spitting linseeds while toasting. Calories per serving listed are for soy (86) or maple syrup (92) version.
